messages.text: The finite barrel check shows clearance for the proposed pickups. I’m finishing the checks against bus conductors, support feet and pipe legs so the assessment can distinguish source geometry clearance from the barrel construction still needed in the native model.

**DES043-SysArch-04 — source geometry supports retaining two 20×64 mm barrel lands, with explicit centres at u=±12 mm.** No additional footprint reduction or reshaping is indicated by this check.

Assessed revision: `8ce2bc3e8fa08ae829606a94d144e6c5cda20166`. Read-only explicit SysArch fallback; no files changed.

The proposed inserts run from host w=−4.05 mm to module lift−0.825 mm. Their heights are **3.225 and 4.725 mm**, below the 8 mm thermal-model limit. The 15° tilted barrel frames, 85.333333 mm row pitch and alternating 1.5 mm lift come from `tools/short_strip_barrel/model.py:75–79,97–144`.

Finite box SAT checks found **zero positive-volume intersections**:

| Checked interface | Minimum positive separating-axis bound |
|---|---:|
| Other active silicon | 3.083765 mm |
| Other guard silicon | 3.012608 mm |
| Other backing | 3.999350 mm |
| Adjacent-row flex | 1.833333 mm |
| Neighbour cold back skin | 1.533980 mm |
| Neighbour old 0.2 mm Cu rail | **1.283132 mm** |
| Neighbour proposed 0.17 mm Cu rail | 1.285266 mm |
| Other proposed pickup | 4.283980 mm |
| Neighbour signal bus | 11.398266 mm |
| Neighbour foot, conservative enclosing box | 12.607942 mm |

These are conservative separation bounds, not exact closest-point distances. The first batch comprised 72,608 comparisons against modules and neighbouring cold supports; an additional 315,808 covered all same-layer staves, Cu rails, signal buses, foot bounding boxes and proposed pickups. Rotational symmetry covers all 288 staves. An 81,776-comparison old-geometry control also found no intersections.

Other finite limits:

- A 20.1×64.1 mm support window leaves **3.95 mm** to the stave edge and **1.95 mm** of backing edge land.
- Adjacent thermal windows remain **21.233333 mm** apart longitudinally.
- Exact pickup polygon radial bounds leave at least **7.707659 mm** to bearing-ring outer surfaces.
- Every pickup reaches its original 2.5 mm OD straight pipe at u=±12. The central rows provide at least **58.666667 mm** of straight-leg intersection per 64 mm pad; other rows provide 64 mm. Source: `tools/short_strip_barrel/export.py:105–125`.

**Required implementation detail:** the old exporter places pickups at **u=±10**, not ±12 (`export.py:167–169`). Retaining that offset leaves 4 mm outer overhang and does not reproduce the redesign ledger’s `[2,16]` mm assumption (`short_strip_redesign/inputs.json:133–144`). Barrel construction should explicitly encode ±12 and cut the backing, front skin/glue and core windows, plus actual pipe saddles. The old unmodified stack cannot establish the proposed thermal path.

This is a source-level geometric inference. Native construction currently covers endcaps only (`short_strip_redesign/native.py:363–367`); barrel CSG, contact probes, overlap checks, tolerances, thermal bond/contact resistance and structural adequacy remain unverified. The current barrel land dimensions are geometrically credible **pending that implementation and validation**.
